name: Forza Horizon 5
offlineNote: Forza Horizon 5 saves your progress to your Xbox profile and syncs it whenever you're online, so anything a mod changes (credits, cars, XP, Wheelspins) goes with you into online play, including if you modded in Solo or offline. Playground Games bans accounts it finds cheating. Use mods only playing offline, and only on progress you're prepared to lose.

info.title: Library
info.body: Every car in Forza Horizon 5 (903) by make, with its class, value, how to get it and stats, pictures, and links to the Forza Wiki.

info.title: Overlay
info.body: Set Display mode to Windowed or Borderless (Video options) for the overlay and Keystone's browser to show on top.
